description: Find census tracts where many veterans live but few or no resources serve them — the highest-impact targets for outreach, partnership development, and grant proposals. Joins our resource directory with US Census ACS 2020–2024 5-year tract demographics. Returns gap_score (veterans per existing resource), socioeconomic context (poverty %, median income), and FIPS location codes. Backed by 84,365-tract dataset covering all 50 states + DC + PR.

max_resources.description: Maximum existing resources to qualify as a "gap"

min_veterans.description: Minimum veteran count to include tract (filter out small ones)

state.description: 2-letter state code to filter (e.g. TX, CA)

name: find_service_deserts
title: Find veteran service deserts
